I have an install like this for my home - minus the solar panels. I just keep the battery bank charged up and then during outages can run off of that, and keep the batteries recharged with a gasoline or propane generator (have both).

I can easily add solar panels to the mix by routing the DC current from the solar panels to a charge controller which then can also charge the battery bank (in the end, the inverter is always getting DC from the battery bank). I actually have solar panels and a charge controller - just haven't bothered to install and hook them up.
